CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assessment_drafts_clear_on_submit()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  -- The draft delete must never block a real assessment insert (Vera D2): if the table is missing
  -- (rolled back out of order) or the delete fails for any reason, warn and let the insert go through.
  begin
    delete from public.assessment_drafts where user_id = new.user_id;
  exception when others then
    raise warning 'assessment_drafts_clear_on_submit: draft delete skipped (%): %', sqlstate, sqlerrm;
  end;
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assessments_autofill_athlete_id()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.athlete_id IS NULL AND NEW.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT id INTO NEW.athlete_id
    FROM public.athletes
    WHERE user_id = NEW.user_id
    ORDER BY created_at ASC
    LIMIT 1;
  END IF;
  IF NEW.user_id IS NULL AND NEW.athlete_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT user_id INTO NEW.user_id
    FROM public.athletes
    WHERE id = NEW.athlete_id
    LIMIT 1;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ensure_notif_prefs_for_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.notification_preferences (user_id, email_reminders, push_reminders, reminder_time, timezone, retest_reminders, weekly_digest)
  VALUES (NEW.id, true, false, '07:00', 'America/New_York', true, false)
  ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO NOTHING;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_users_protected_columns()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  if current_user in ('postgres','supabase_admin','supabase_auth_admin','service_role','dashboard_user') then
    return new;
  end if;
  if new.id is distinct from old.id
     or new.email is distinct from old.email
     or new.created_at is distinct from old.created_at
     or new.portal_role is distinct from old.portal_role
     or new.school_id is distinct from old.school_id
     or new.coach_id is distinct from old.coach_id
     or new.platforms is distinct from old.platforms
     or new.sports_enabled is distinct from old.sports_enabled
     or new.subscription_status is distinct from old.subscription_status
     or new.subscription_tier is distinct from old.subscription_tier
     or new.subscription_expiry is distinct from old.subscription_expiry
     or new.stripe_customer_id is distinct from old.stripe_customer_id
     or new.stripe_subscription_id is distinct from old.stripe_subscription_id
     or new.paywall_frozen_until is distinct from old.paywall_frozen_until
     or new.grandfathered_at is distinct from old.grandfathered_at
     or new.base_status is distinct from old.base_status
     or new.base_stripe_subscription_id is distinct from old.base_stripe_subscription_id
     or new.base_expiry is distinct from old.base_expiry
  then
    raise exception 'users: protected column change rejected for role %', current_user
      using errcode = '42501', hint = 'Entitlement and billing fields are set by the Stripe webhook only.';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_consent_signed()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  update public.athletes
  set
    terms_accepted_at          = new.signed_at,
    medical_waiver_accepted_at = case when new.medical_waiver_version is not null
                                      then new.signed_at else medical_waiver_accepted_at end,
    onboarding_status          = case when onboarding_status = 'pending_consent'
                                      then 'consent_signed' else onboarding_status end,
    updated_at                 = now()
  where user_id = new.user_id;
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.increment_message_count()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ BEGIN UPDATE public.ai_conversations SET message_count = message_count + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = NEW.conversation_id; RETURN NEW; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.push_subscriptions_cap()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.push_subscriptions WHERE user_id = NEW.user_id AND disabled_at IS NULL) >= 10 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'push_subscriptions: device limit reached' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_schools_updated_at()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN NEW.updated_at = now(); RETURN NEW; END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tg_after_consent_insert()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  update public.clients
     set onboarding_step = 'assessment',
         current_terms_version = new.terms_version,
         current_waiver_version = new.medical_waiver_version
   where user_id = new.user_id;
  return new;
end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tg_pe_consent()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  perform public.log_product_event(new.user_id, 'consent_signed',
    jsonb_build_object('terms_version', new.terms_version, 'waiver_version', new.medical_waiver_version));
  return new;
end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tg_pe_lead()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  perform public.log_product_event(null, 'lead_assessment_submitted',
    jsonb_build_object('lead_id', new.id, 'source', new.source, 'tier', new.tier, 'prs_score', new.prs_score, 'is_test', public.is_test_account(new.email)));
  return new;
end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tg_pe_protocol_session()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  perform public.log_product_event(new.user_id, 'protocol_session_logged',
    jsonb_build_object('session_date', new.session_date, 'protocol_day', new.protocol_day), new.sport);
  return new;
end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tg_pe_sport_entitlement()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if tg_op = 'INSERT' or new.status is distinct from old.status then
    perform public.log_product_event(new.user_id, 'sport_entitlement_changed',
      jsonb_build_object('from', case when tg_op = 'UPDATE' then old.status end, 'to', new.status, 'expires_at', new.expires_at), new.sport);
  end if;
  return new;
end; $function$
